model_roles._note: model_roles is the primary per-role setup; any role may use provider 'ollama' or 'anthropic'. eval is optional (defaults to the validator); a local eval alternative is {"provider": "ollama", "model": "gemma4:12b", "think": false}. chat is the finance chat in the app (defaults to model_name); with a Claude chat role, category and merchant names and aggregated summaries leave this machine, never transaction rows. Anthropic roles need the anthropic package and credentials from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or `ant auth login`, never this file; their prompts (report data and evidence) leave this machine. Claude roles take max_tokens (up to 64000; thinking counts toward it, so a Claude author needs about 32000), effort, optional stream (default: automatic above 16000 max_tokens) and thinking (only "adaptive").model_server_url is the shared Ollama server; model_name is still used by legacy mode, fact extraction, and the Finance Summary and QA app.

_guidance_note: strict (default) suits small local authors; guided (for strong authors such as Claude Opus) keeps every snapshot fact exact but allows free wording/structure and an optional labeled alternative savings plan, sends all validator errors to revisions, and doubles max_tool_calls/max_calls_per_tool. model_roles.author.guidance overrides this key.
